text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aim for the Takoyaki Classic~♪ Fast, 
cheap, and tasty! Takomaru Triple Crown 
Hall~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Mornin', Trainer! Listen to this, I 
had the most awesome dream!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When I won a graded race, y'know, the 
Prime Minister gave me a lifetime 90% off 
coupon for takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A boat of takoyaki that's usually 300 yen, 
for only 30 yen! It's a total revolution!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I'm all fired up! I'm gonna win a 
ton and make this dream come true~!
